Privacy Policy

Effective Date: September 29, 2026

Zero-Upload Guarantee: All screenshot rendering, styling, image resizing, and OpenGraph card generation happens 100% locally in your web browser. No uploaded images or canvas outputs are ever transferred to or stored on our servers.

1. Data We Do Not Collect

We do not collect, view, transmit, or retain your raw screenshots, mockup contents, source code snippets, or exported graphic files. Everything runs client-side using Web APIs (HTML5 Canvas & Blob rendering).

2. Payment & License Information

Payments are securely processed by PayPal Inc. DevSnapKit never stores credit card details or financial credentials. When you purchase a Pro Lifetime Pass, we only verify the transaction reference to issue your cryptographic license key.

3. Local Storage

We store your Pro license activation status and UI preferences in your browser's standard localStorage. You may clear this at any time through your browser settings.

4. Contact Us

If you have any questions or privacy inquiries, contact us directly at support@devsnapkit.com.
